name: Jummah Mosque
subtitle: A large mosque in the middle of Chinatown in central Port Louis.

facts.label: Founding
facts.value: Founded 1852 when a small Muslim community acquired land in the city centre.

facts.label: Government listing
facts.value: Ministry of Tourism: 'built in the 1850's, in the middle of Chinatown'.

facts.label: Wooden staircase
facts.value: Entirely wooden spiral staircase, once used by the muezzin to call to prayer.

facts.label: Size
facts.value: Around 3,000 people pass through for Friday prayers and big occasions.

parts.text: A large mosque in the middle of Chinatown in central Port Louis. It grew from a small mosque on land bought in 1852 into the present building.
